variants.headline: Union calls a strike
variants.body: The union {name} has called a strike. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.

variants.headline: A call to withhold labour
variants.body: A strike has been called by the union {name}. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.

variants.headline: Work becomes the subject of a strike call
variants.body: The union {name} has issued a call for strike action. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.
